text:
sara_sales: Hey @finance — need a quick sign-off for a one-off concession for Arbor Systems. They want 40% off the first 6mo, waive onboarding fee ($12k), and Net45. We expect them to ramp to ~$1.2M ARR after month 6. Need finance + legal okay by EOD to hit their procurement window.

mike_finance: Can you drop ACV and expected committed spend? 40% is pretty big. Also do we have a proposed clawback if they underutilize?

josh_salesops: Copying the model we ran in spreadsheet. Quick numbers:```
List price MRR (post-discount ramp): $85k
6mo revenue w/40% off: ~$255k
Estimated 12mo post-ramp ARR: $1.2M
One-time waived onboarding: $12k
Total one-off concession (discount + onboarding): est $150k-180k
```

linda_cfo: 150k+ concession needs exec approval. I'm OK to approve up to $150k if legal signs off on a robust clawback and SalesOps certifies forecast. Anything above that needs a formal deal desk review.

elena_legal: We'll need a short amendment: minimum 12-mo committed term, carve out a usage minimum (>=60% of committed in first 3 months) or pro-rated clawback of discount. Also add a clause that onboarding waiver is forfeited if they cancel before 12 months. I can draft language today.

billing-bot: reminder: custom terms require billing code CT-EXC and ops ticket created. Template: /ops create-billing-ticket --deal arbor-systems --type CT-EXC

sara_sales: Thanks. Proposed compromise: reduce upfront discount to 30% for months 1-6, keep onboarding waiver, require 12-mo commit. Clawback: if usage <60% in first 3 months, revert to standard pricing and invoice the diff pro-rated for months 1-3. That keeps us protected and still helps close.

mike_finance: 30% + clawback + onboarding waiver with max concession cap $150k = I can greenlight from finance side. Please add explicit measurement windows and reporting cadence to the amendment.

linda_cfo: +1 conditioned on legal language and SalesOps sign-off that forecast is realistic. Also require customer PO referencing the amended terms.

elena_legal: I'll draft the amendment now and share in this thread. I'll include the clawback formula and a sample PO clause.

josh_salesops: I'll run the sensitivity model and confirm expected utilization by 4pm. If results look within tolerance, I'll attach the numbers to the ops ticket.

sara_sales: Great — thanks everyone. Tagging @elena_legal and @josh_salesops. I'll wait for your doc and then get PO. Plan: close by EOD if all good :raised_hands:

billing-bot: ops ticket CT-EXC created: #98765 (attach amendment when ready).
